s: Ambaji Mohanthal Prasad, which received a GI tag on 8 October 2026, belongs to which State?
x: Ambaji Mohanthal Prasad is the gram-flour sweet offered to Goddess Ambaji at the Ambaji Temple in Banaskantha district, Gujarat.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Ambaji Temple, a Shakti Peetha, is in Banaskantha district.
2. The Geographical Indications Registry has its headquarters in Mumbai.
3. A GI registration is valid for 10 years and is renewable.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. The GI Registry is headquartered in Chennai, not Mumbai.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Geographical Indications in India?
o: The GI Act, 1999 came into force on 15 September 2003
Darjeeling Tea was the first GI product of India
The GI Registry works under DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
Ambaji Mohanthal Prasad is a sweet made of rice flour
x: Ambaji Mohanthal Prasad is made of gram flour, not rice flour; the other statements are correct.

s: Mahesh Kakde, winner of the 2026 Ramanujan Prize for Young Mathematicians from Developing Countries, is a professor at which institution?
x: Mahesh Kakde is a professor at the Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bengaluru, established in 1909.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Ramanujan Prize for Young Mathematicians from Developing Countries is for mathematicians below 45 years of age.
2. The prize carries USD 10,000.
3. The ICTP, which supports the prize, has its headquarters in Geneva.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. ICTP is headquartered in Trieste, Italy, not Geneva.

s: In October 2026, Telangana Samagra Shiksha received which ISO certification for quality management in school education?
x: Telangana Samagra Shiksha got the ISO 9001:2015 certification, a quality management standard.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Telangana rose from 28th to 18th in the Performance Grading Index (PGI).
2. Samagra Shiksha was launched in 2018 under the Ministry of Education.
3. NIPUN Bharat was launched in 2019.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. NIPUN Bharat was launched in 2021, not 2019.

s: In October 2026, SBI was named the World's Best Consumer Bank 2026 for the second consecutive year by which magazine?
x: Global Finance magazine (est. 1987, HQ Manhattan, New York) named SBI the World's Best Consumer Bank 2026.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the State Bank of India (SBI)?
o: It was formed by nationalising the Imperial Bank of India
It received the World's Best Consumer Bank 2026 award in Singapore
x: SBI received the award at the World's Best Bank Awards in Bangkok, during the IMF Annual Meetings, not in Singapore.

s: Reema Nanavaty, who received the Hillary Rodham Clinton Award-2026, is Director of which organisation?
x: Reema Nanavaty of Gujarat is Director of SEWA, which represents over 20 lakh informal women workers.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. SEWA was founded in 1972 by Ela Bhatt.
2. SEWA has its headquarters in Ahmedabad.
3. Ela Bhatt received the Ramon Magsaysay Award in 1986.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Ela Bhatt got the Ramon Magsaysay Award in 1977; 1986 is the year of her Padma Bhushan.

s: Where were the ₹100 commemorative coin and ₹5 postal stamp honouring musician Ghanshyam Das Jain unveiled in October 2026?
o: Dr Ambedkar International Centre, New Delhi
x: They were unveiled at the National Annual Cultural Conclave held at the Dr Ambedkar International Centre, New Delhi.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Commemorative coins in India are issued by the Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance.
2. India Post works under the Department of Posts, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Only statement 1 is correct. The Department of Posts is under the Ministry of Communications.

s: Which body won the European Parliament's Sakharov Prize for Freedom of Thought-2026?
x: The International Criminal Court (ICC) and its officials won the Sakharov Prize 2026, amid US sanctions on the ICC.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the International Criminal Court (ICC)?
o: It was set up under the Rome Statute of 1998
Its headquarters is at The Hague
India is a State Party to it
x: India is not a State Party to the ICC (nor is the US); the other statements are correct.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Sakharov Prize was established in 1988.
2. It was first awarded jointly to Nelson Mandela and Anatoly Marchenko.
3. It carries EUR 100,000 and a citation.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. The Sakharov Prize carries EUR 50,000, not EUR 100,000.

s: Tomoko Akane, President of the International Criminal Court, belongs to which country?
x: ICC President Tomoko Akane is from Japan.

s: RUDHRA, an Indian device among the global Top 20 finalists of the James Dyson Award-2026, is a:
x: RUDHRA is a voice-based Braille printer that converts speech to Braille using speech recognition and Raspberry Pi.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The James Dyson Award was launched in 2010 by the James Dyson Foundation.
2. Braille was developed by Louis Braille in 1824 and uses a six-dot cell.
3. World Braille Day is observed on 4 January.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 2 and 3 are correct. The James Dyson Award was launched in 2005, not 2010.

s: Ashoke Sen delivered the Oskar Klein Memorial Lecture on 22 October 2026 at the AlbaNova Centre of which university?
x: The lecture 'Gravity from Strings and Strings from Gravity' was delivered at AlbaNova Centre, Stockholm University.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Oskar Klein Medal carries no cash prize.
2. The Oskar Klein Memorial Lecture was instituted in 1998.
3. ICTS, which announced Ashoke Sen's medal, was set up in 2007 in Bengaluru under TIFR.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. The Oskar Klein Memorial Lecture was instituted in 1988, not 1998.

s: Ashoke Sen, the first Indian to receive the Oskar Klein Medal (2026), won which prize in 2012 as its inaugural awardee?
x: Ashoke Sen won the inaugural Fundamental Physics Prize in 2012 and the Padma Bhushan in 2013.

s: Which of the following pairs (awardee – award, 2026) is correctly matched?
o: Ashoke Sen – Charles Correa Gold Medal
Mahesh Kakde – Ramanujan Prize for Young Mathematicians
x: Mahesh Kakde won the Ramanujan Prize. Ashoke Sen won the Oskar Klein Medal, Radhakrishnan M.S. the Charles Correa Gold Medal and Prashant Chaudhary the Rohini Nayyar Prize.

s: Radhakrishnan M.S., winner of the 28th Charles Correa Gold Medal, is a student of SEED APJ Abdul Kalam School of Environmental Design in which city?
x: Radhakrishnan M.S. studies at SEED APJ Abdul Kalam School of Environmental Design, Kochi.

s: Which of the following pairs of works of architect Charles Correa and their places is INCORRECTLY matched?
x: Bharat Bhavan designed by Charles Correa is in Bhopal, not Indore; the other pairs are correct.

s: In which city was Lionel Messi presented the Princess of Asturias Award for Sports-2026 on 23 October 2026?
x: Messi received the award on 23 October 2026 in Oviedo, Spain, from Princess Leonor.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Princess of Asturias Awards were instituted in 1981 and have eight categories.
2. Lionel Messi is the first footballer to win the Princess of Asturias Award for Sports individually.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Both statements are correct.

s: President Droupadi Murmu released a ₹200 commemorative coin on the 200th birth anniversary of Mata Sahib Hasi Devi Ji at Lok Bhavan in which city?
x: The coin was released at Lok Bhavan, Raipur, Chhattisgarh.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Mata Sahib Hasi Devi Ji was the fifth spiritual head of Shadani Darbar of the Sindhi community.
2. Chhattisgarh was formed on 1 November 2001.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Only statement 1 is correct. Chhattisgarh was formed on 1 November 2000.

s: The inaugural Bhupen Hazarika National Award, to be given to Usha Mangeshkar, was instituted by which State Government?
x: The Bhupen Hazarika National Award was instituted by the Assam Government.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Bhupen Hazarika National Award carries ₹10 lakh and is given once every three years.
2. PM Modi is to present the inaugural award on 29 November 2026 at Vigyan Bhawan, New Delhi.
3. Bhupen Hazarika was given the Bharat Ratna posthumously in 2019.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. The award is to be presented at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, not Vigyan Bhawan.

s: Indian photographer Sitaram Raul's photo 'Shifting Sand' won which category at Wildlife Photographer of the Year 2026?
x: 'Shifting Sand', showing an Indian Buthacus scorpion burrowing, won the Behaviour: Invertebrates category.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Wildlife Photographer of the Year is organised by the Natural History Museum, London, and was first held in 1965.
2. The overall winner of 2026 was Federico Veronesi for 'The Aftermath'.
3. Sitaram Raul's winning photo was taken near Sam village in the Thar Desert of Gujarat.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Sam village in the Thar Desert is in Rajasthan, not Gujarat.

s: Scorpions, like the Indian Buthacus scorpion in the photo 'Shifting Sand', belong to which class?
x: Scorpions belong to phylum Arthropoda, class Arachnida.

s: In which city was the 70th Ballon d'Or ceremony held on 26 October 2026, the first outside France or Switzerland?
x: The 70th ceremony was held at the London Palladium, London.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Ballon d'Or was instituted by France Football in 1960.
2. The first Ballon d'Or winner was Stanley Matthews.
3. The women's Ballon d'Or has been given since 2018, first won by Ada Hegerberg.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 2 and 3 are correct. The Ballon d'Or was instituted by France Football in 1956, not 1960.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Ballon d'Or 2026?
o: Harry Kane plays for Bayern Munich
Alexia Putellas won her third women's title
Harry Kane is the first Englishman to win it in 25 years
x: Alexia Putellas plays for Barcelona Femeni, not Chelsea; the other statements are correct.

s: The Socrates Award, won by Bukayo Saka in 2026, is named after a footballer from which country?
x: The Socrates Award, introduced in 2022, is named after Brazil's Socrates Brasileiro.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Socrates Award was introduced in 2022.
2. Bukayo Saka, with the German charity BigShoe, funded 120 surgeries for children in Ghana.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Only statement 1 is correct. The surgeries funded by Saka and BigShoe were for children in Nigeria.

s:
Arrange the following in chronological order of their institution:
1. Ramanujan Prize for Young Mathematicians from Developing Countries
2. Ballon d'Or
3. Socrates Award
4. Sakharov Prize
x: Ballon d'Or (1956), Sakharov Prize (1988), Ramanujan Prize (2005) and Socrates Award (2022).

s: Which Indian city will host the Earthshot Prize 2026 ceremony, the first time in India?
x: Mumbai will host the 6th annual Earthshot Prize ceremony on 17 November 2026.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Earthshot Prize was launched by Britain's Prince William in 2020.
2. Each Earthshot Prize winner gets £1 million.
3. The Earthshot Prize has six categories.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. The Earthshot Prize has five categories, not six.

s: Which of the following is NOT a category of the Earthshot Prize?
x: The five categories are Protect and Restore Nature, Clean Our Air, Revive Our Oceans, Build a Waste-Free World and Fix Our Climate.

s: Flydubai Captain Smith Machar was given which UAE honour in October 2026?
o: First Class Order of Zayed II
x: Captain Smith Machar received the First Class Order of Zayed II for reportedly preventing an attempt to bring down a Flydubai aircraft.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The honour was presented by Dubai Crown Prince Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum on behalf of the UAE President.
2. Dubai is the capital of the UAE.
3. Flydubai began operations in 2009.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. The capital of the UAE is Abu Dhabi, not Dubai.

s: The 5th Rohini Nayyar Prize for Rural Development (2026) was won by Prashant Chaudhary, founder of which organisation?
x: Prashant Chaudhary founded CodeYogi Foundation, which works on AI education in rural areas.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Rohini Nayyar Prize is for people under 45 years of age.
2. It carries ₹10 lakh cash, a citation and a trophy.
3. The 2026 prize was presented on 31 October 2026 at India International Centre, New Delhi.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 2 and 3 are correct. The prize, instituted in 2022, is for people under 40, not 45.
